STANDARD Works immediately without setup. Measurements stay on this device.
ADB TURBO Reserved for verified elevated access. SHIELD TURBO does not pretend that enabled debugging or a one-time permission equals permanent shell authority.
ROOT Only actual root process authority counts. The app does not invoke su merely to fill in a badge.
Picture brightness uses Android display-over-other-apps permission only when dimming below 100%.
